topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I can hardly believe what I'm reading. The notice is right there, taped to the bulletin board: my apartment building is being converted into condominiums. This can't be happening. All these years, I've been here, thinking I had a home, a place that was mine, no matter what. Now they're telling me I either need to buy my unit or find somewhere else to live. I've poured so much of myself into this place, and now, all of a sudden, it feels like I'm losing everything. How am I supposed to come up with the money to buy? Where will I go? This is more than just a change; it feels like my whole world is tipping.
